knownDeltas: This tranche freezes form-shell, validation-summary, and remediation-banner semantics as token-backed GPUI composites before the repo ships mounted native composite widgets for every form surface.

Browser-origin announcement and relationship patterns are kept explicit through announcement mode, blocking counts, and field-reference models, but native accessibility event wiring remains later GPUI runtime work.
The composite layer now depends on the widened GPUI primitive surface rather than inventing one-off validation or remediation posture in downstream apps.
nonGoals: Do not treat this tranche as proof that broader GPUI browse, detail, picker, media, or workstation composites are complete.
Do not claim final native accessibility proof from composite-level validation and remediation specs alone.
Do not fold app-specific workflow logic or domain validation engines into this generic GPUI composite baseline.
